design: No design section: PLAN-03 P6 (MOD-04), D-040 e, f, g; PD-03; PD-07; Q-52; KI-130. Port of the live taxBuildHarvest (index.html, PR #36).
note: Hand-worked by NB-03 (CHAT-010) for the financial review; not the design's known answers. Each case lists holdings by client, name, I-21 class (the key of classify.ts INST) and the long-term (lt) or short-term (st) unrealised gain in rupees. As on 30 Sep 2026: tax year 2026-27, the Sec 198 exemption Rs 1,25,000 per person (table v1 section 10.2) at 12.5%. inputs.slab is the analyst's slab rate per client (percent; absent = not entered, PD-07); inputs.exemptionUsed is the analyst's entry per client (a rupee amount or "unused-confirmed"); inputs.statement is the statement person-year exemption.applied per client (Q-52). Expected figures are rupees, unrounded; null is the dash "slab rate not set".

cases.note: A losing LT holding inside a class that nets positive (ltPos 3,00,000, ltNeg 1,00,000), exemption confirmed unused. Sec 198 gains G = 3,00,000; unused exemption 1,25,000; slots: above the exemption 1,75,000 at 12.5%, inside it 1,25,000 at 0%. Before: 3,00,000 x 12.5% = 37,500 less 1,25,000 x 12.5% = 15,625, so 21,875. The LT loss 1,00,000 goes to the slot above the exemption first (rank 12.5% before 0%): left 2,00,000. After: 2,00,000 x 12.5% = 25,000 less 15,625 = 9,375. Saving 12,500 = 1,00,000 x 12.5%.

variants.note: The statement's person-year exemption.applied for the client (its only person) is 50,000, so 75,000 is unused. Before: 37,500 less 75,000 x 12.5% = 9,375, so 28,125. The loss 1,00,000 goes above the exemption (slot 2,25,000): left 2,00,000; after 25,000 less 9,375 = 15,625. Saving 12,500.

cases.note: H-1 with nothing known about the exemption already used this year (no analyst entry, no statement): Q-52 labels the result "exemption not applied" and no exemption enters the figures (the live assumed Rs 0 used, giving H-1's figures). Before 3,00,000 x 12.5% = 37,500; after 2,00,000 x 12.5% = 25,000; saving 12,500.

variants.note: Slab 10% ranks the slab gain below the 20% equity ST gain: the loss 50,000 takes the 40,000 equity gain first (saving 8,000), then 10,000 of the slab gain (sheltered, no tax figure). After 0.

PD-07, no slab entered: at slab 0% the loss goes to the equity gain first (after 0), at 30% to the slab gain first (after 8,000). The two differ, so the after-set-off figures are the dash "slab rate not set"; the tax before (8,000, the slab gain unquantified) stands.

variants.id: H-3 no slab, losses cover all
variants.note: No slab entered, but the ST loss 2,00,000 exceeds every gain (1,20,000): any slab rate gives the same set-off, so the figures stand. After 0; saving 8,000; 80,000 of the loss unused.

cases.note: An ST loss against slab gains with the slab entered as 30%: the slab gain ranks at 30%, above the 20% equity ST gain, so the loss 50,000 goes to the slab gain (no tax figure; 50,000 slab-sheltered, 30,000 left). Before: 40,000 x 20% = 8,000; after 8,000; saving 0. The candidate is the losing holding.

PD-03 (D-043, TX-23): crypto kept out of set-off. The crypto gain 40,000 is taxed in full at 30% (12,000) before and after; the crypto loss 60,000 reduces no gain and the losing coin is not a candidate. Before: 2,00,000 x 12.5% = 25,000 + 50,000 x 20% = 10,000 + 12,000 = 47,000, less the exemption 1,25,000 x 12.5% = 15,625: 31,375. After the same; saving 0. Pooled (wrong): the 60,000 loss would take the 40,000 crypto gain (30%) and 20,000 of the equity ST gain (20%), a saving of 16,000.

Two clients, never pooled (D-040 f, TX-08). A: 1,50,000 LT gain, exemption 1,25,000: 25,000 x 12.5% = 3,125 before and after. B: a 1,00,000 LT loss and no gain: 0, the loss unused. Family = the sum: 3,125 / 3,125 / saving 0. Pooled (wrong): 50,000 net, inside one exemption, tax 0, a false saving of 3,125.

variants.note: A loss of 2,00,000: 1,50,000 fills the slot above the exemption, the other 50,000 goes inside it (0%) and saves nothing. Left 50,000, all inside the exemption: after 50,000 x 12.5% less 50,000 x 12.5% = 0. Saving 18,750 = 1,50,000 x 12.5%, not 2,00,000 x 12.5%.

cases.note: The s.198 slot: two Sec 198 classes (Equity MF 2,00,000; listed shares 50,000; G = 2,50,000), 25,000 of the exemption already used (analyst entry), so 1,00,000 unused. Slots: 1,50,000 above the exemption at 12.5%, 1,00,000 inside at 0%. Before: 2,50,000 x 12.5% = 31,250 less 1,00,000 x 12.5% = 12,500: 18,750. The LT loss 90,000 is spent above the exemption first; left 1,60,000, of which 1,00,000 is inside: after 1,60,000 x 12.5% = 20,000 less 12,500 = 7,500. Saving 11,250 = 90,000 x 12.5%.
